from.place: Tag 09RE proof, affine case: rewrite derived Hom from a bounded finite-projective complex as homotopy-complex maps and commute the finite presentation calculation with the filtered colimit

title: Affine full faithfulness for a perfect complex over a filtered colimit
statement: Let (A_i)_{i in I} be a filtered system of rings with colimit A, and let A_0 be one stage. Let E_0 be a bounded complex of finite projective A_0-modules and let K_0 be a complex of A_0-modules. Put E_i=E_0 tensor_{A_0} A_i, K_i=K_0 tensor_{A_0} A_i, E=E_0 tensor_{A_0} A, and K=K_0 tensor_{A_0} A. If K_0 is K-flat, then the canonical map $\operatorname{colim}_{i \ge 0} \operatorname{Hom}_{D(A_i)}(E_i,K_i) \to \operatorname{Hom}_{D(A)}(E,K)$ is an isomorphism. Here $D(-)$ and K-flatness are the notions used in [def-pc-derived-category], and the bounded finite-projective source is the affine form of [def-pc-perfect-complex].
